root_cause.text: The ipset hash:* IPv4 range-adding loops in `hash_ipmark4_uadt()`, `hash_ipport4_uadt()`, `hash_ipportip4_uadt()`, and `hash_ipportnet4_uadt()` advanced the 32-bit `ip` iterator as part of the `for` increment, causing iteration to run one step past `ip_to` and corrupt the saved retry position (`h->next`) for large ranges.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes each loop from `for (; ip <= ip_to; ip++...)` to manual incrementing with `if (ip == ip_to) break; ip++;`, and the commit message explicitly says “The iterator must stop once the last address in the requested range has been processed” because advancing it once more “can move the traversal state past the end of the request,” affecting later retries.
